set.body: Acceptance criteria: versioned canonical codecs cover normalized recordings, frame and clock specs, plans, validated configurations, warnings, provenance operations, and large-payload digests; recipe serialization reproduces results or returns named incompatibility; live FS2 execution provides progress and cancellation without changing pure Machine semantics; plugin interfaces extend detectors and measures without kernel modification; app-facing visualization data preserves source ranges, labels, AOIs, excluded time, and uncertainty; round-trip, migration, cancellation, and cross-platform fixtures pass.
set.title: Versioned app boundary, recipes, live progress, and plugins
